premise: On its way to a far comet, a probe swoops close past the Moon to borrow speed, turns to send one picture home through the satellite, and is gone.
inspiration: Homer's 'Odyssey', where the traveller is caught at every island, turned: this traveller never stops — it waves, borrows a push, and sails on.
lesson: A friend's help along the way can send you further.
learning: A probe can swing close past a moon or planet to borrow speed and change direction.

en-US.title: The Probe Swings By
en-US.text: {comet:float loop 0.2} {probe:float loop 0.3} {station:float loop 0.3} {satellite:float loop 0.3} Far, far away, a {comet:enter} comet was glowing. And a little {probe:enter} probe was on its long way to meet it. [curious] But space is big, and the probe was small. How could it go faster? {probe:pulse} It did something clever. It aimed straight for the Moon. {sfx:whoosh} Whoosh! It swooped close past the Moon and the {station:enter} space station, {probe:go to station} and the Moon's pull swung it round like a stone in a sling. {probe:spin} [excited] Faster now, and on a brand-new path! {station:wobble} But first, {probe:live} it turned its dish and snapped one picture of the Moon below. The {satellite:enter} satellite {satellite:live} caught the picture and sent it home to Earth. {sfx:beep} {all:face happy} Everyone who saw it smiled: the grey plain, {all:hop} the tiny base, the Earth peeping over the ridge. [softly] {probe:go away right} And the probe sailed off toward its comet, faster than ever. {comet:glow 0.6}

es-ES.title: La sonda que pasó de largo
es-ES.text: {comet:float loop 0.2} {probe:float loop 0.3} {station:float loop 0.3} {satellite:float loop 0.3} Muy, muy lejos, brillaba un {comet:enter} cometa. Y una pequeña {probe:enter} sonda iba de camino a su encuentro. [curious] Pero el espacio es enorme, y la sonda era pequeña. ¿Cómo podría ir más deprisa? {probe:pulse} Hizo algo muy listo. Apuntó directa a la Luna. {sfx:whoosh} ¡Fiuuu! Pasó rozando la Luna y la {station:enter} estación espacial, {probe:go to station} y la fuerza de la Luna la hizo girar como una piedra en una honda. {probe:spin} [excited] ¡Más rápida, y con un rumbo nuevo! {station:wobble} Pero antes, {probe:live} giró su antena e hizo una foto de la Luna. El {satellite:enter} satélite {satellite:live} recogió la foto y la envió a la Tierra. {sfx:beep} {all:face happy} Todos los que la vieron sonrieron: la llanura gris, {all:hop} la base diminuta, la Tierra asomando por las montañas. [softly] {probe:go away right} Y la sonda se fue hacia su cometa, más rápida que nunca. {comet:glow 0.6}

whoosh.prompt: a soft airy whoosh sweeping past, smooth and playful

beep.prompt: a single soft electronic radio beep, clean and friendly
